Synthetic / fictional job description for Fresh Top-3 final trusted-chain validation.

Company: Fictional Search Quality Studio (synthetic sandbox employer).
Role: Search Quality Platform Engineer.
Location: Beijing or remote within China. Seniority: mid-level. Product stage: established internal tooling.
The fictional team builds tools for evaluating and improving document-search quality for internal users.

Must-have requirements:
- Python backend engineering for data or search services.
- Search or information-retrieval systems, including retrieval quality analysis.
- Reproducible evaluation workflows and clear technical metrics.

Nice-to-have requirements:
- FastAPI or equivalent typed HTTP service development.
- PostgreSQL-backed data workflows.
- Containerized local development with Docker.

Evaluation focus: inspect concrete search-system and evaluation evidence, distinguish project technology from personal contribution, and identify the first requirement that needs direct verification.
